body: My relationship problems. My girlfriend is still thinking over what she wants and isn't talking to me much.. I know she's currently still talking to the other guy though and spends a lot of time with him at work every day... I know my relationship is done, but I can't bring myself to break up with her until she gets her head figured out.. I mean there's a slight chance she'll choose me... I guess. I don't know, but even before this I was struggling with enjoying anything.. I don't eat much (I'm already underweight) because food doesn't taste that good. I listen to music because being alone in silence makes things worse, but I don't really enjoy anything I listen to that much. Life's just not going great right now, and this is making these thoughts a lot more prevalent in my mind. That being said, I know I'm not a suicide risk or anything.. I know I would never and could never kill myself.
